snippet.title: Advent NEON - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Advent NEON is officially (and finally!) hitting Steam on July 18th (20 USD /w a 10% discount at launch)! Get ready to tear through the entirety of Neopolis, with absurdly fast attacks, insane schmovement and the abilities to stop time and transform into a superpowered state! It's been a long time coming, and the wait will have been worth it! 

Thank you all for the support over the years! And to people seeing the game for the first time, be sure to give it a wishlist on Steam AND try out its free demo if you like what you see! 

Check it out!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528260/Advent_NEON/
Follow the game on Twitter & Bluesky: https://twitter.com/adventneon
https://bsky.app/profile/adventneon.bsky.social


Advent NEON is an upcoming hyperactive 2D indie action platformer that is being solo-developed by CryoGX. While it takes inspirations from classic titles like Sonic the Hedgehog and Megaman Zero, it has its own identity by giving the player access to a full platform fighter moveset, time-stopping and skill-based power scaling that can unleash an even stronger form for those who can earn it!

Also for some additional context: if you're seeing people mention FNF (Friday Night Funkin'), this is because I made an FNF mod back in 2021 to help make people aware of Advent NEON's existence (that, and it was just fun to do). However, the game did already exist and was announced well before then, but that FNF mod became one of the largest sources of traffic toward the game's demo at the time. "That guy from FNF" is kind of a recurring joke in the comments of anywhere I post because of this lol. 

Even more context!: While games like Sonic the Hedgehog are but one of the inspirations for this game, you'll quickly see (and feel!) that there are many ways that Neon's gameplay differs from 'em at a fundamental level! It's much more like a playable version of those those flash-era sprite animations than it is a direct "clone" of any specific game. If you're one of the very few players who's ready to chalk up Advent NEON as simply a clone of anything, despite what you're seeing in the trailer, give the demo a shot, and feel for yourself just how much that timestop, 8-way dashing and an entire platform fighter moveset (with busted frame data) changes up the game! You've got the tools, out the gate, to go on an absolute power trip, should you master them!

#CryoGX #AdventNEON #Gamedev #Indiedev
